uart.signal: committed ELF fixture (crates/firmware-nrf52833-demo) booted in-sim; assert_uart_contains matches 'OK\\n' on a real bus.attach_uart_tx_sink capture. The stream is produced by UARTE0 EasyDMA on PSEL.TXD = P0.06 (the micro:bit v2 interface-MCU bridge) after BAUDRATE/ENABLE/STARTTX. Fixture absence is a hard assert!, not a skip.

spi.gap: The descriptor declares SPIM2/SPIM3 (shared nRF52 SPIM model), but no firmware or harness on this chip drives SPI: no tier-1 fixture, no matrix sketch, no bus-level executing gate for nrf52833.

i2c.gap: The descriptor declares i2c0 (SPIM0/TWIM0 mux) and twi1 (shared nRF52 TWIM model), but no firmware or harness on this chip drives I2C: no tier-1 fixture, no matrix sketch, no bus-level executing gate for nrf52833.
